units.E_V_vs_AgCl_3MKCl: applied cathode potential, V vs Ag/AgCl (3 M KCl), nominal value of the run (marker x read back in E_read_from_marker_V)
units.conc_mM_as_plotted: mM of the species as plotted (N2 per molecule)
units.conc_mM_N: mM of nitrogen: conc_mM_as_plotted x 2 for N2, x 1 otherwise
units.match_score: normalized cross-correlation (template_match) or ring-darkness score (ring_fit); low values mark overlapped markers, not wrong positions

structure: 24 rows: 6 potentials (-1.8 to -2.8 V in 0.2 V steps) x 4 species (NO3, NO2, NH3, N2), concentration in the catholyte after 1 h of electrolysis. N2O was measured in these runs (text: about 5 % selectivity at -2.8 V) but is not plotted.
extraction_method: Raster digitization of the thesis page image (reader page 116, 300 dpi) by an agent script (OpenCV). x calibrated from the six labelled major ticks (-1.8 V at px 785 to -2.8 V at px 1771, linear fit residuals below 0.0003 V); y from the eight ticks 0-35 mM (0 at px 1219.5, 30 mM at px 480; 24.64 px/mM, residuals below 0.01 mM). Filled squares (NO3-), filled down-triangles (N2) and open up-triangles (NH3) located by normalized cross-correlation with templates cut from the -2.8 V markers, searched within +-6 px of each potential tick; anchors are the square centre and the triangle centroids (circumcentres). Open circles (NO2-) located by a ring fit (radius 8.75-9.5 px; arc hidden by the x-axis line excluded). Overlapped markers: NO2- at -1.8 V (under the N2 triangle), NH3 at -2.2 V (apex under the NO3- square; matched on the visible base). The NO3- line is the author's fitted curve and was not digitized. Overlay of the inverse-calibrated points on the page crop checked by eye (scratch, not committed). 1 px = 0.04 mM.
n_basis_note: N2 plotted per molecule, established three ways: (1) text, N2 selectivity about 85 % at -2.8 V: 2 x 21.05 / (50 - 0.75) = 85.5 % (per-N reading would give 43 %); (2) N closure with x2 for N2 (N2O not plotted): 0.88, 0.92, 0.98, 1.03, 1.02, 0.99 from -1.8 to -2.8 V; (3) Table 6.11 at -2.0 V, where the 1 h conversion (71.6 %) matches the table's 70 %: the table's partial current efficiencies (NO2- 1.32 %, NH3 14.5 %, N2 45.2 %, taking 2, 8 and 10 electrons per NO2-, NH3 and N2) imply NO2-/NH3 = 0.364 and NH3/N2 = 0.401 mol/mol; digitized 0.364 and 0.398.

text_facts: Final NO3- at -2.8 V 48 mg/L = 0.77 mM: digitized 0.75 mM
N2 selectivity about 85 % at -2.8 V: digitized 85.5 % (N2 x2 over NO3- removed)
NH3 maximum at -2.4 V, 13.37 mM: digitized 13.36 mM
NH3 at -2.8 V 6.45 mM (110 mg/L): digitized 6.42 mM
NO2- at -2.8 V 0.2 mg/L = 0.004 mM: digitized 0.02 mM (marker on the axis, within 1 px of zero)
Text says NO3- conversion at -2.8 V exceeded 99 %; 48 mg/L of a 50 mM start is 98.5 % and the figure gives 98.5 %
checks.table_6_11_comparison: Table 6.11 is at 70 % conversion, so it is directly comparable only at -2.0 V (1 h conversion 71.6 %), where it agrees (see n_basis_note). At -2.2 to -2.8 V the 1 h endpoints are at 83-98.5 % conversion and the product ratios differ from the table's 70 % values (e.g. NO2-/NH3 0.066 vs 0.094 at -2.2 V; NH3/N2 0.305 vs 0.553 at -2.8 V), as expected for later sampling.
checks.cross_figure: At -2.4 V this diagram gives NO3- 4.52, NH3 13.36, N2 16.54 mM after 1 h; Diag 6.4 (same conditions, time course) gives 6.88 / 13.04 / 15.53 at 60 min and 3.23 / 13.34 / 16.59 at 90 min. The 1 h endpoint here lies between the 60 and 90 min points of Diag 6.4, so they are probably different runs (or the endpoint was not exactly 60 min).

conditions.cell: divided_batch (Teflon cell, Nafion 117 H+ form, 10 mL per compartment, platinized Pt anode, Luggin capillary)
conditions.potential_as_reported: -1.8 to -2.8 V vs Ag/AgCl (3 M KCl), one run per potential
conditions.notes: Ambient temperature (not given numerically). NO3-/NO2- by ion chromatography, NH3 by OPA fluorescence, N2 (and N2O) by on-line GC-TCD with instantaneous readings integrated.
